about: Persons, places and things whose Wikipedia article the corpus could not tell from a namesake's. Each entry lists the Wikidata items that go by the record's names and have an article, with what each has in common with the record. Answering with one tells every load to link the record to that item's articles; answering none leaves the record without a link. The load rewrites the open entries and keeps the answered ones.
